text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia appeals to Turkey not to interfere in Iraq.
- President Ben Ali chairs a cabinet meeting, recommends cutting back on bureaucratic procedures.
- New governors named for the provinces of Sfax, Ariana and Monastir.
- President Ben Ali confers with minister of the interior Mohamed Jegham. Mohamed Soudani named as new director general of political affairs department at the Interior Ministry.
